title: Measuring Model Robustness via Fisher Information: Spectral Bounds, Theoretical Guarantees, and Practical Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2606.04767v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The robustness of deep neural networks is crucial for safety-critical deployments, yet existing evaluation methods are often attack-dependent and lack interpretability. We propose a principled, attack-agnostic robustness metric based on the spectral norm of the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM), which quantifies the worst-case sensitivity of the model's output distribution to input perturbations. Theoretically, we establish that the FIM equals the variance of the input Jacobian and derive closed-form spectral bounds for common architectures, including VGG, ResNet, DenseNet, and Transformer, providing the first theoretical robustness ranking. To enable scalable evaluation, we develop efficient algorithms, including power iteration and Hutchinson-based estimation, that support both white-box and black-box settings. translated_title: 基于Fisher信息的模型鲁棒性度量：谱界、理论保证与实用算法
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络的鲁棒性对于安全关键型部署至关重要，然而现有的评估方法往往依赖于特定攻击且缺乏可解释性。我们提出了一种有原则的、与攻击无关的鲁棒性度量，该度量基于Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）的谱范数，量化了模型输出分布对输入扰动的最坏情况敏感度。在理论方面，我们证明了FIM等于输入雅可比矩阵的方差，并为VGG、ResNet、DenseNet和Transformer等常见架构推导了闭式谱界，提供了首个理论鲁棒性排名。为实现可扩展的评估，我们开发了高效的算法，包括幂迭代法和基于Hutchinson的估计方法，可同时支持白盒和黑盒两种设置。我们在CIFAR、ImageNet和医学图像等多个数据集以及多种架构上进行了大量实验……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Fisher信息矩阵谱范数的、与攻击无关的模型鲁棒性度量，为常见架构推导了闭式谱界并给出首个理论鲁棒性排名，同时提供了适用于白盒和黑盒场景的高效估计算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an attack-agnostic robustness metric based on the spectral norm of the Fisher Information Matrix, deriving closed-form spectral bounds and the first theoretical robustness ranking for common architectures, along with efficient estimation algorithms for both white-box and black-box settings.
